description: This file contains C++ source code implementing evaluation frame handling and callback mechanisms for TorchDynamo, including functions for custom evaluation frames, recursion limits, and cache management.

classes.name: CRecursionLimitRAII
classes.description: RAII class for managing Python thread state recursion limits, with different implementations depending on Python version.

methods.name: dynamo_call_callback
methods.description: Invokes a Python callback with the current evaluation frame and cache information.

methods.name: _callback_from_action
methods.description: Returns a handle based on the specified frame action (SKIP, RUN_ONLY, or callback).

methods.name: dynamo_set_c_recursion_limit
methods.description: Sets the C recursion limit for evaluation, with validation.

methods.name: dynamo_get_c_recursion_limit
methods.description: Retrieves the current C recursion limit.

methods.name: dynamo__custom_eval_frame
methods.description: Custom evaluation frame function that manages cache, guard evaluation, and callback invocation during Python frame execution.

methods.name: dynamo_set_code_exec_strategy
methods.description: Sets the execution strategy for a specific code object.

methods.name: dynamo_skip_code_recursive
methods.description: Marks a code object to be skipped recursively during evaluation.
